data.title: Ethereum spot ETFs see $270M inflows on Sept 21... | Pluang
data.description: On September 21, Ethereum spot ETFs attracted a total of $270 million in net inflows, with BlackRock's iShares Ethereum Trust (ETHA) leading by drawing $110 million, about 41% of the total. This inflow indicates strong institutional demand for Ethereum spot ETFs, though the remaining $160 million was spread across other funds, showing diverse interest. While this single-day data highlights positive momentum, it does not guarantee a sustained trend as inflows can fluctuate. The SEC's ongoing review of crypto ETF products may influence future market dynamics for these funds.
data.author: Coincu
